arxiv-1901-04220.title: Introducing HIJING++: the Heavy Ion Monte Carlo Generator for the High-Luminosity LHC Era
arxiv-1901-04220.creator: Gergely Gábor Barnaföldi, Gábor Papp, Miklos Gyulassy, Péter Lévai, Xin-Nian Wang, Ben-Wei Zhang
arxiv-1901-04220.description: Abstract Beyond 2025 we will enter the High-Luminosity era of the LHC, right after the upgrades of the third Long Shutdown of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC). The ongoing state-of-the-art experimental instrument upgrades require high-performance simulation support in the background, that is modern, robust, and comes with long term support.

arxiv-2111-02097.title: Mitigating long queues and waiting times with service resetting
arxiv-2111-02097.creator: Ofek Lauber Bonomo 1 , Arnab Pal 2 and Shlomi Reuveni 1
arxiv-2111-02097.description: Abstract What determines the average length of a queue which stretches in front of a service station? The answer to this question clearly depends on the average rate at which jobs arrive to the queue and on the average rate of service.

arxiv-2309-07716.title: Understanding Vector-Valued Neural Networks and Their Relationship with Real and Hypercomplex-Valued Neural Networks Thanks: This work has been partially supported by the National Council for Scientiﬁc and Technological Development (CNPq) under grants 315820/2021-7 and São Paulo Research Foundation
arxiv-2309-07716.creator: Marcos Eduardo Valle
arxiv-2309-07716.description: Abstract Despite the many successful applications of deep learning models for multidimensional signal and image processing, most traditional neural networks process data represented by (multidimensional) arrays of real numbers. The intercorrelation between feature channels is usually expected to be learned from the training data, requiring numerous parameters and careful training.

arxiv-2402-19467.title: TV-TREES: Multimodal Entailment Trees for Neuro-Symbolic Video Reasoning
arxiv-2402-19467.creator: Kate Sanders Nathaniel Weir Benjamin Van Durme
arxiv-2402-19467.description: Abstract It is challenging for models to understand complex, multimodal content such as television clips, and this is in part because video-language models often rely on single-modality reasoning and lack interpretability. To combat these issues we propose TV-TREES, the first multimodal entailment tree generator.

arxiv-2404-07480.title: Geometric Observability of Hypergraphs
arxiv-2404-07480.creator: Joshua Pickard *, Cooper Stansbury, Amit Surana, Indika Rajapakse, Anthony Bloch
arxiv-2404-07480.description: Abstract In this paper we consider aspects of geometric observability for hypergraphs, extending our earlier work from the uniform to the nonuniform case. Hypergraphs, a generalization of graphs, allow hyperedges to connect multiple nodes and unambiguously represent multi-way relationships which are ubiquitous in many real-world networks including those that arise in biology.

arxiv-2406-03532.title: An Empirical Calibration of the Tip of the Red Giant Branch Distance Method in the Near Infrared. II. JWST NIRCam Wide Filters
arxiv-2406-03532.creator: Max J. B. Newman, Kristen B. W. McQuinn, Evan D. Skillman, Martha L. Boyer, Roger E. Cohen, Andrew E. Dolphin, O. Grace Telford
arxiv-2406-03532.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Max J. B. Newman, Kristen B. W. McQuinn, Evan D. Skillman, Martha L. Boyer, Roger E. Cohen, Andrew E. Dolphin, O. Grace Telford. The tip of the red giant (TRGB) is a standardizable candle and is identifiable as the discontinuity at the bright extreme of the red giant branch (RGB) stars in color-magnitude diagram (CMD) space.

arxiv-2411-05251.title: Cochordal zero divisor graphs and Betti numbers of their edge ideals
arxiv-2411-05251.creator: Le Xuan Dung, Thanh Vu
arxiv-2411-05251.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Le Xuan Dung, Thanh Vu. We associate a sequence of positive integers, termed the type sequence, with a cochordal graph. Using this type sequence, we compute all graded Betti numbers of its edge ideal. We then classify all positive integer n n such that the zero divisor graph of ℤ / n ​ ℤ \ZZ/n\ZZ is cochordal and determine all the graded Betti numbers of its edge ideal. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2506-04600.title: Achieving Linear Speedup and Near-Optimal Complexity for Decentralized Optimization over Row-stochastic Networks
arxiv-2506-04600.creator: Liyuan Liang, Xinyi Chen, Gan Luo, Kun Yuan
arxiv-2506-04600.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Liyuan Liang, Xinyi Chen, Gan Luo, Kun Yuan. A key challenge in decentralized optimization is determining the optimal convergence rate and designing algorithms to achieve it. While this problem has been extensively addressed for doubly-stochastic and column-stochastic mixing matrices, the row-stochastic scenario remains unexplored. This paper bridges this gap by introducing effective metrics to capture the influence of row-stochastic mixing matrices and establishing the first convergence lower bound for decentralized learning over row-stochastic networks.

arxiv-2509-01406.title: 𝓝 = 𝟐 \mathcal{N}=2 AdS hypermultiplets in harmonic superspace

arxiv-2512-06959.title: Hereditary History-Preserving Bisimilarity: Characterizations via Backward Ready Multisets
arxiv-2512-06959.creator: Marco Bernardo ORCID:0000-0003-0267-6170, Andrea Esposito ORCID:0009-0009-2259-902X, Claudio A. Mezzina ORCID:0000-0003-1556-2623
arxiv-2512-06959.description: Abstract . We devise two complementary characterizations of hereditary history-preserving bisimilarity (HHPB): a denotational one, based on stable configuration structures, and an operational one, formulated in a reversible process calculus. Our characterizations rely on forward-reverse bisimilarity augmented with backward ready multiset equality.

arxiv-2602-07606.title: The Parameterized Complexity of Independent Set and More when Excluding a Half-Graph, Co-Matching, or Matching Thanks: NM received funding from the European Research Council (ERC) with grant agreement No. 101126229 – buka .
arxiv-2602-07606.creator: Jan Dreier, Nikolas Mählmann, Sebastian Siebertz
arxiv-2602-07606.description: Abstract A theorem of Ding, Oporowski, Oxley, and Vertigan implies that any sufficiently large twin-free graph contains a large matching, a co-matching, or a half-graph as a semi-induced subgraph. The sizes of these unavoidable patterns are measured by the matching index , co-matching index , and half-graph index of a graph.

pmc-10557183.title: Feasibility, acceptability and lessons learned from an infant feeding intervention trial among women living with HIV in western Kenya
pmc-10557183.creator: Ann E Maltby, Belinda C Odhiambo, Maureen Nyaura, Rosemary Shikari, Emily L Tuthill
pmc-10557183.description: BackgroundThe World Health Organization recommends mothers breastfeed exclusively for the first six months of their infant’s life. However, women living with HIV in low resource settings face many barriers to recommended infant feeding practices such as fear of HIV transmission and perceived milk insufficiency. Moreover, current support for breastfeeding in this context is often insufficient to overcome these barriers.

pmc-11484170.title: Advanced morphological control over Cu nanowires through a design of experiments approach†
pmc-11484170.creator: Andrea Conte, Antonella Rosati, Marco Fantin, Alessandro Aliprandi, Marco Baron, Sara Bonacchi, Sabrina Antonello
pmc-11484170.description: Copper nanowires (CuNWs), featuring anisotropic highly conductive crystalline facets, represent an ideal nanostructure to fabricate on-demand materials as transparent electrodes and efficient electrocatalysts. The development of reliable and robust CuNWs requires achieving a full control over their synthesis and morphology growth, a challenge that continues to puzzle materials scientists.

pmc-11504007.title: Exploring Intra-Articular Administration of Monoclonal Antibodies as a Novel Approach to Osteoarthritis Treatment: A Systematic Review
pmc-11504007.creator: Amarildo Smakaj, Elena Gasbarra, Tommaso Cardelli, Chiara Salvati, Roberto Bonanni, Ida Cariati, Riccardo Iundusi, Umberto Tarantino
pmc-11504007.description: Biological drugs, including monoclonal antibodies, represent a revolutionary strategy in all fields of medicine, offering promising results even in the treatment of osteoarthritis (OA). However, their safety and efficacy have not been fully validated, highlighting the need for in-depth studies.

pmc-12567757.title: Onabotulinumtoxin-A for Chronic Migraine in Children and Adolescents: A Narrative Review of Current Evidence and Clinical Perspectives
pmc-12567757.creator: Laura Papetti, Paolo Martelletti, Massimiliano Valeriani
pmc-12567757.description: Chronic migraine (CM) in childhood and adolescence is associated with a high disease burden, including impaired quality of life, school absenteeism, and reduced daily functioning. OnabotulinumtoxinA (ONA) is approved for prophylactic treatment of CM in adults, but its use in pediatric patients remains off-label, with evidence still limited.

pmc-13074078.title: Association Between Long-Term Exposure to Particulate Matter and Glycated Hemoglobin Levels: A Cohort Study from the Korean Genome and Epidemiology Study
pmc-13074078.creator: Kyeongmin Kwak, Saemi Jung, Daeil Kwon, Seryeon Lee
pmc-13074078.description: Background: Ambient air pollution, particularly particulate matter (PM), has been linked to metabolic disorders, including diabetes. We evaluated associations between long-term exposure to coarse particulate matter (PM10) and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) and glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels in a Korean population and assessed whether specific subgroups exhibited heightened susceptibility.

pmc-13234087.title: A monolithic patient-specific 3D–0D model for In silico investigation of hemodynamics in patients with left ventricular assist devices
pmc-13234087.creator: Mia Bonini, Marc Hirschvogel, Michael Ferguson, Francis Pagani, Paul C. Tang, David Nordsletten
pmc-13234087.description: We present a fully coupled, patient-specific 3D–0D computational framework for hearts supported with left ventricular assist devices (LVAD) that enables controlled in silico experimentation. The approach monolithically integrates three-dimensional CFD of the left ventricle (LV), left atrium (LA), aortic root, and LVAD cannulae with a closed-loop 0D lumped parameter network of the full circulation.

pmc-13450843.title: Social vulnerability and health determinants of Intrinsic Capacity in Mexican older adults: Evidence from the Mexican Health and Aging Study round 2021
pmc-13450843.creator: Miriam Teresa López-Teros, Fabiola Yocupicio Medrano, Karla Animas Mijangos, Omar Yaxmehen Bello-Chavolla, Alberto Jose Mimenza-Alvarado, Sara Gloria Aguilar-Navarro, Guillermo Salinas-Escudero, Guillermo Salinas-Escudero, Guillermo Salinas-Escudero
pmc-13450843.description: BackgroundPopulation aging has increased interest in Intrinsic Capacity (IC), defined as the composite of physical and mental abilities that support healthy aging. Because declines in IC precede disability, IC is a useful framework for characterizing individuals with greater vulnerability in later life.
